before: With w:balanceSingleByteDoubleByteWidth, legacy compressed-punctuation lines keep natural inter-word spaces.
after: With w:balanceSingleByteDoubleByteWidth, legacy compressed-punctuation lines shrink each space down to a quarter of its font size to keep one more word.
reason: Only derived layout changes. Shared nodes, canonical UTF-16 offsets, operations, and package serialization remain unchanged. Peers with the same fonts lay out the same lines.
